name: VeeMost Technologies Holdings, Inc.
summary: VeeMost Technologies Holdings, Inc. is no longer engaged in investment activities. Previously, this principal investment firm concentrated on acquiring and providing early-stage funding to developing companies. Its approach included either acquiring businesses outright as wholly owned subsidiaries or making minority equity investments. The company aimed to be the primary investor, wielding significant influence over management. Furthermore, it assisted its portfolio companies in expanding through mergers and acquisitions, preparing them for an eventual exit either through an initial public offering or a direct sale. Their investment strategy was not restricted by any specific industry or geographical location. VeeMost Technologies Holdings, Inc. was founded in 2006 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.
